control: before every block: budget check, perfect-calibration-payoff ceiling, then bounded first pilot or capped previous empirical slope
preference: alpha starts at 1/4; after each available checkpoint alpha=clip(alpha+(1-2*mean_correct)/8,0,1/2)
final_selection: best available calibration utility at terminal alpha, ties prefer earlier checkpoint; all executed updates paid
tariff_scope: declared utility-unit scenarios; not dollar or measured CPU prices; horizons are not new tasks
evidence_scope: retrospective mechanism study on repeatedly inspected archived AG News; no prospective efficacy
stopping_guarantee: perfect-payoff ceiling is algebraic on the empirical utility scale; slope extrapolation has no future-optimality guarantee
